name: spiro-erp
description: Spiro ERP Phase 1 — admin dashboard + offline-first POS PWA + shared API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,admin,pos -c green,cyan,yellow --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix pos"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix pos
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix pos
